case: P04/E03 OpenAI × Chat Completions history conversion, reasoning replay, tool results and images
source: Synthetic offline fixture. Chunk shapes follow OpenAI's streamed Chat Completions (stream_options.include_usage) as consumed by pi-ai 0.87.1 (commit 898ab804050730e9dcefb4443875d5a932aa6a32) packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.ts through openai-node 6.40.0 (Stream.fromSSEResponse). Expected requests follow pi's buildParams and convertMessages for the standard OpenAI compat; the models are pi's OpenAI data on the openai-completions API (ADR-0013). Costs are pi's calculateCost at the frozen prices of the model used.

scenarios.about: A same-model turn answered by the host: the reasoning goes back under the field it streamed in, the text as the content string, the call with its parsed arguments, the result as a tool message; instructions go to a reasoning model as developer.
Same-model reasoning_details are sent back as they were streamed instead of the reasoning field; blank text is dropped.
Older history kept encrypted reasoning on tool calls' thought signatures: it goes back as reasoning_details.
The round trip's history restored without the host vouching for it: the thinking replays as plain text (joined into the content) and no reasoning field is sent; the downgrade is counted.

A Responses turn replayed to Chat: visible reasoning becomes text, signatures go, the id 'call_1|fc_1' becomes 'call_1_fc_1' and its result follows; a long Anthropic id is cut to 40 characters for OpenAI.
A Responses call id whose item id makes it longer than 40 characters is shortened with a hash, so calls sharing a call id stay distinct.
A model taking images: the user image as an image_url data URL; a run of tool results goes out as tool messages ('(see attached image)' for an image-only one), then their images in one user message.
The same images to a text-only model (gpt-4): pi's placeholders replace them and no image message follows the results.
